title: Forms and Transformation Semantics
objective: Separate species from form and define explicit transformation changes and retention across anatomy, scale, movement, senses, equipment, attributes, grants, resources and presentation while preserving base identity/history and provenance-safe reversal.
boundaries: MVPS-09 owns form identity, form composition and transformation semantics only; base species identity remains MVPS-01 and lineage composition remains MVPS-08.

A form is a governed body/state configuration distinct from species identity and must use stable references to morphology, scale, movement, senses, capabilities, resources, equipment behavior and presentation owners rather than copy their mechanics.

Transformation records must make source form, target form, entry trigger/cost, duration, retained/replaced contributions, equipment handling, exit/reversal, visibility and provenance explicit where applicable.
Temporary form state may not erase base species/lineage selections or historical receipts.
Equipment mutation remains with Item/Equipment owners; MVPS-09 specifies retain/drop/suppress/resize/replace/adapt policy references, not inventory ownership engines.
Species progression/maturation remains MVPS-10 and runtime active-contribution projection/receipts remain MVPS-13.
MVPS-10+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: Fresh-read MVPS-01 through MVPS-08 and current form/transformation/equipment/resource owner contracts, then establish causal RED and implement the bounded MVPS-09 tranche.
